about: Coating and thin-film deposition: method (class keys with units), move, home, gap, set-temp, vacuum, prime, start (job), stop, result, status. power, open/close, estop, ack and wait come from the shared layer. Ranges come from each member's contract in the unit the argument declares.

excluded.buchi_minispray: spray dryer: its job is drying a feed to a powder (evaporation package, primary there); the twin has no coating operation or substrate, so no coating verb would lower to anything new
excluded.glatt_miniglatt: fluid-bed processor: particle coating is one operation of its method (operation=coating, top or bottom spray) next to drying and granulation; it is primary in the formulation package, whose method / start / stop / result verbs cover it, so a coating part would only duplicate them

move: the stage moves at --speed (default: the documented example speed) and the verb waits until it is there; --job returns a job instead
home: homing runs once after switching on (manual: turning on); the verb waits until it is home
method: one step: coating length, stage speed, pump flow, stage delay (manual p.19-29; the wet film is flow / (width x speed))
prime: fill the line and form the meniscus under the die before coating (manual p.30-38)
gap: gap of 1-10 x the wet film thickness (manual p.39-41)
set-temp: hot-plate set point; `set-temp off` switches the heater off

method: one controller segment: temp, heating rate, hold; gas flows per channel in sccm (= mL/min), pressure, purge time (datasheet: controller curves, mass-flow channels)
set-temp: works in fixed controller mode (method mode=fixed); in programme mode the curve sets the temperature
vacuum: `vacuum pump --pressure 30Pa` pumps in automatic pressure control; plain `vacuum pump` uses the documented example settings
start: --mode cvd (default, needs a substrate) or --mode purge
